description:
Moz group buy access can help you find keyword ideas, check backlinks and compare websites at a lower cost. This SEOGBTools page explains what Moz Pro tools do and what to check before choosing a plan.

If you run a blog, manage a business website or research SEO for clients, start with the tasks you need to do. Compare the tools, daily limits and access period as well as the price.

Before you order: SEOGBTools is a separate service and does not claim to be an official Moz partner. Shared access is different from your own Moz subscription. Features and saved projects may be limited, and access can stop if the account changes or is restricted. Review the current offer and Moz's terms before paying.

What Is Moz Pro Group Buy?

Moz Pro group buy means buying shared or managed access from a provider rather than subscribing directly to Moz. The provider gives access to the tools listed in its offer.

A shared Moz account does not automatically give you a private account, all paid features or unlimited searches. Ask which tools open, how many reports you can use and what happens to saved work if the account changes.

What Can You Do with Moz Pro Tools?

Moz Pro has tools for keyword research, link research, website checks and ranking reports. The sections below explain their main uses. Check which features are included in your chosen offer.

Find Keywords with Keyword Explorer

Keyword Explorer helps you find related search terms and questions. You can compare search volume, keyword difficulty and the pages already ranking for a topic.

Search volume is an estimate of how often people search for a term. Keyword difficulty helps you judge how hard it may be to rank. Use these numbers as a guide, then read the actual search results and choose topics you can answer well.

If you are comparing Moz Keyword Explorer pricing, check how many searches, lists and downloads are included. The tool name alone does not tell you the limits.

Check Backlinks with Link Explorer

A backlink is a link from another website to yours. Link Explorer helps you check these links and the websites they come from. You can use it to study your own site or compare links to competing pages.

Referring domains means the different websites linking to a page or site. Use the reports to find useful sources and understand which content attracts links. Ask whether full link reports and downloads are included in the plan.

Understand Domain Authority and Page Authority

Domain Authority (DA) and Page Authority (PA) are scores made by Moz. DA looks at a website, while PA looks at a page. These scores help with comparison, but they are not scores given by Google and do not promise better rankings.

Read a website's content and check whether it serves a real audience. A high score alone does not make a link or website useful for your work.

Check Website Issues with Site Crawl

Site Crawl helps you find SEO issues to review, such as broken links, page title problems and pages that search engines may struggle to reach. Use its findings to make a clear list of fixes.

Ask whether you can create a campaign, how many pages can be checked and whether you can run checks again. A shared plan may allow research without ongoing website checks.

Track Rankings and Use MozBar

Rank tracking follows selected keywords over time where the plan supports saved campaigns. MozBar is Moz's browser extension for quick page research and selected SEO information.

MozBar is separate from an extension used by a provider to give shared access. Check browser needs and extension permissions before setting up either one.

Moz Pricing: Compare the Cost and the Limits

Searching for Moz prices or the cost of Moz Pro? First decide whether you want an official Moz subscription or access from a separate provider. These offers can have different features, limits and account control.

Moz pricing plans should be compared using the final amount, access period and reports you can actually use. A low price may suit quick research but may not suit daily client projects or large report downloads.

Check the current SEOGBTools purchase option for this offer. To compare official Moz Pro pricing, visit the Moz Pro pricing page. Confirm current prices there rather than relying on old coupon pages.

Shared Access or Your Own Moz Subscription?

With shared access, you buy from a separate provider and use the tools allowed by its offer. Searches, downloads and saved work may be limited.

When you buy Moz Pro directly, your account and features follow the official plan you choose. A private subscription may suit teams that need separate users, saved campaigns or private client work.

Moz Pro, Moz Local and Moz API are different products or services. Do not assume that Moz Local tools or an API key are part of a shared Moz Pro plan. If you need these, check their own pricing and access details.

A Simple Moz Research Plan

  1. Choose one topic that matters to your audience.
  2. Find related keywords and check the search results.
  3. Study a few competing pages and their backlinks.
  4. Write helpful content and review page issues.
  5. Track your own impressions and clicks in Google Search Console.

For other research options, browse our SEO tools shop.

How to Get Moz Access Through SEOGBTools

  1. Read the product details and open the purchase option.
  2. Confirm the tools, search limits, access method and access period.
  3. Place your order when the plan fits your needs.
  4. Follow the setup steps and test your main reports.

Ask whether access uses a dashboard, browser session or extension. Confirm supported devices and payment methods before ordering.

Compare Moz with Ahrefs and Semrush

Moz, Ahrefs and Semrush can all help with keyword and link research. Choose based on the reports you find useful and the limits of each offer.

Read our Ahrefs group buy page and Semrush group buy page to compare the options. These are separate products unless a bundle clearly includes them together.

Shared Access: Limits and Saved Work

Shared plans may limit searches, downloads, campaigns and people using the account at the same time. Access may also stop during login changes or account restrictions. Keep copies of useful research and avoid storing private client details in a shared account.

Moz Group Buy FAQs

How much does Moz cost?

The cost depends on whether you choose official Moz Pro access or a separate provider's offer. Compare the final price, billing period and included reports before paying.

Does Moz group buy include every Moz Pro tool?

Do not assume so. Ask about Keyword Explorer, Link Explorer, Site Crawl, ranking reports and the limits for each tool.

Can I use Moz for backlink research?

Moz Link Explorer is designed for link research. Confirm that it is included in the offer and ask about report and download limits.

Does Moz sell backlinks?

Moz provides research tools for studying links. Buying access to these tools is different from buying backlinks or paying to raise a website score.

Are Moz Local and Moz API included?

Not automatically. Ask about each product separately. Moz API pricing and Moz Local pricing should not be treated as the price of this Moz Pro access offer.

Is there a free Moz Pro trial or discount?

Check Moz's current official offers. A trial or coupon mentioned on an old page may no longer apply. A provider's shared plan is separate from an official trial.

Can I keep saved campaigns and track rankings?

Ask whether campaigns are available, how many keywords or pages are allowed and how long your work stays saved. Keep important findings outside the shared account.

Is a higher Domain Authority score enough to rank?

No. It is a comparison score from Moz. Useful content, relevant links and a website that works well still matter.

What happens if access stops?

Contact the provider with your order details and follow the support, replacement or refund terms for your purchase.

Choose Moz Access That Fits Your Work

Compare the reports you need, the amount of research you do and the privacy your work requires. If a feature or limit is unclear, contact SEOGBTools support before you order.
